_meta.description: Safe/unsafe claim ceilings derived from domain-level evidence (v9.7.89). A locus is matched to the FIRST rule whose trigger roles are all present (or whose any-of triggers fire). All claims are architecture/family-level capacity statements — never product identity. Aligned with the standing rules: capacity language only, KCB = similarity not identity.

rules.safe_claim: NRPS/PKS assembly-line architecture supported by domain and aSModule evidence
rules.unsafe_claim: confirmed product scaffold or monomer sequence without substrate validation

rules.safe_claim: siderophore/metallophore-like biosynthetic and uptake/export evidence present
rules.unsafe_claim: confirmed named siderophore identity without LC-MS/MS or genetic evidence

rules.safe_claim: lanthipeptide maturation machinery present; candidate lanthipeptide-family locus
rules.unsafe_claim: SapB-like/morphogen overcalled as conventional antibiotic, or named lanthipeptide without precursor validation
rules.ceiling: lanthipeptide-family; SapB-like context unless antibiotic evidence exists

rules.safe_claim: azole-containing/crocagin-style RiPP tailoring evidence present; candidate RiPP-family locus
rules.unsafe_claim: confirmed cacaoidin or named azole-RiPP product without precursor validation
confirmed RiPP product without precursor validation

rules.safe_claim: accessory/uncharacterised domain content; no clean biosynthetic-core architecture
rules.unsafe_claim: biosynthetic lead based on accessory domains alone
rules.ceiling: accessory-only; not a clean architecture call
